hypotheses.claim: First evaluation Worker module/processor initialization delays the first reply long enough to fill the eight-frame queue.
Initial storage session creation or first append delays persistence and then evaluation commit enough to hit a queue watermark.
Steady-state solve/clone/validation or storage service time is slower than production; startup preparation alone may not solve it.

minimalDiagnosticProposal.origin: Widen the internal onEvaluationBackpressure callback to receive evaluation|storage; pass the explicit literal from each existing queue callback. Existing zero-argument callbacks remain source-compatible.
minimalDiagnosticProposal.capturePoint: At the start of runtime onEvaluationBackpressure, before pauseCore, retain exactly one bounded diagnostic snapshot: origin, world.tick/simulation time, monotonic wall time, recording duration, evaluation telemetry and persistence telemetry. Keep the original pause behavior, capacities and watermark semantics unchanged.
minimalDiagnosticProposal.readout: Use the existing e2e debug runtime exposure for this diagnostic only, with an explicit read-only diagnostic getter or pinned retained snapshot. Do not present this method as production DOM verification; no hidden state mutation, no auto-resume, no queue polling in the audio callback.
minimalDiagnosticProposal.optionalTiming: If needed after identifying the lane, add bounded fixed fields for evaluation Worker create/first send/first reply and persistence create-ready/first append completion. Do not log each tick or collect an unbounded event list.

oneRun.method: One fresh owned browser/context, same scene, browser, DPR1, source/audio settings, 60Hz clock and default Levels header; use public Enable/Run/Start recording, make no header switch for a bounded 10s or until first guard. On first guard, immediately read the retained snapshot, then stop/finalize via public UI and await cleanup.
oneRun.controls: Root freezes source/bundle/executable and runs no competing heavy jobs. No cap raise, accepted tick omission, forced resume, fake clock, weaker expectation or retry.
oneRun.interpretation: A repeated guard without a header switch plus captured origin isolates this failure from the new mode click. Snapshot identifies the constrained lane; first-response timing is needed before declaring cold startup the root cause.

conditionalReadinessContract.worker: A bounded prepare/ready handshake, with generation/id/timeout validation, completes before admitting recording ticks. It performs no acoustic solve/event generation, does not increment accepted/processed watermarks, and does not restart an existing ready worker.
conditionalReadinessContract.storage: If storage readiness is implicated, expose/await the existing session create promise while the physics producer remains paused; retain the empty candidate/session identity until creation is committed. Failed/cancelled creation cannot publish a recording or silently delete a prior valid artifact.
invariants: Keep fixed dt 1/60, queue8/32MiB and low2/8MiB; do not drop or overwrite accepted ticks.
Use existing runtime transaction busy and pauseGeneration/live ownership checks before and after awaits. Dispose/reset/focus pause must prevent late readiness from resuming time.
A failed preparation is terminal for that owned preparation attempt; user retry begins a fresh bounded generation and cannot reuse a stale reply/session.
Publish preparing/pending state explicitly, preserve scene/run/source identity, and release acquired transport assets on failure/cancellation.
Steady-state overload still uses the original pause guard; preparation is not a claim that sustained throughput meets the original performance gate.

independentReview.method: Independent source and failure snapshot read only
independentReview.conclusion: Shared callback/message confirmed; no evident queue accounting bug; both cold-start hypotheses require actual telemetry.

limits: No product source edited, no test/browser run, and no performance or root-cause PASS claimed.
Existing failure and all numeric capacities/thresholds remain unchanged.
